name: redis-dev
description: Local Redis dev container with persistence disabled

just.snippet:
REDIS_CONTAINER := "jtr-redis-dev"
REDIS_PORT := env_var_or_default("REDIS_PORT", "6379")

# Start a local Redis container (no persistence).
redis-up:
    @docker rm -f {{REDIS_CONTAINER}} 2>/dev/null || true
    docker run --rm -d \
      --name {{REDIS_CONTAINER}} \
      -p {{REDIS_PORT}}:6379 \
      redis:7-alpine --save "" --appendonly no
    @echo "redis ready on redis://localhost:{{REDIS_PORT}}"

# Stop the local Redis container.
redis-down:
    -docker stop {{REDIS_CONTAINER}}

# Open a redis-cli against the local Redis container.
redis-cli:
    docker exec -it {{REDIS_CONTAINER}} redis-cli
